aptlondon_master-st-pauls__studio.title: Studio | master St. Paul's | London
aptlondon_master-st-pauls__studio.desc: Delve into the magic of London via master St. Paul’s Studio serviced apartment. Enjoy the coziness of the space in the center of the city. Book today!

blocks.text: Experience the vivacious heart of London, indisputably one of the most animated and diverse cities worldwide. This one-of-a-kind global metropolis embodies a thriving, multicultural, and cosmopolitan microcosm. Read more

Connect with the dynamic spirit of London, as millions go about their everyday lives. Serving as the perfect starting point to absorb the city’s essence, our Studios, spanning from 18 to 22 sq. m. are designed for up to 2 guests, providing a snug and compact living arrangement. Unwind after a day of discovery of nearby iconic attractions such as Buckingham Palace, the lively theater hub of the West End, bustling Piccadilly Circus, and monumental Trafalgar Square.

The well-appointed Studios come complete with essential amenities for your convenience. Cook up a storm in our fully-equipped kitchen, featuring a stovetop and a combined microwave-oven, making your favorite meal prep a breeze. For coffee enthusiasts, a coffee machine stands ready to provide your favorite brew whenever the mood strikes. Entertainment is assured with a Smart TV, while high-speed Wi-Fi caters to your work and leisure requirements. Additional amenities include a safe deposit box, ironing facilities, and a washer-dryer machine. Read Less

bldtel-aviv_master-mazeh.desc: Alójate en master Mazeh Tel Aviv Aparthoteles: 54 apartamentos con servicios en Tel Aviv, que combinan las comodidades de un hotel con la calidez de un hogar.

blocks.text: master Mazeh Tel Aviv Apartahoteles se encuentra en un barrio tranquilo que conserva el encanto y carácter de la primera Tel Aviv. La calle está flanqueada por edificios históricos de las décadas de 1920 y 1930, que muestran una mezcla de estilos ecléctico y Bauhaus, reflejo de los orígenes de la ciudad. Muchos de estos tesoros arquitectónicos han sido recientemente restaurados y se han convertido en visita obligada para los amantes del diseño y para quienes buscan descubrir un lado más sosegado de la bulliciosa metrópoli.

A pesar de su atmósfera tranquila, nuestra ubicación te sitúa en el epicentro de la vida cultural de Tel Aviv. A pocos minutos a pie encontrarás el emblemático bulevar Rothschild, conocido por sus animados cafés, su vida nocturna y sus zonas verdes. En solo 15 minutos podrás pasear por el bullicioso mercado de Carmel o relajarte en la playa de Aviv, disfrutando del equilibrio perfecto entre tranquilidad y vida urbana.

Nuestros Apartahoteles cuentan con 54 unidades espaciosas y modernas, de entre 42 y 60 m², ideales para alojar de 4 a 6 personas. Diseñados pensando en tu comodidad y conveniencia, son perfectos tanto para estancias cortas como prolongadas.

Cada apartamento dispone de una kitchenette totalmente funcional con nevera, vitrocerámica, combinación microondas-horno y máquina de café espresso para empezar el día con energía. Ofrecemos Internet de alta velocidad gratuito y Chromecast integrado para que permanezcas conectado y entretenido en todo momento. Pensamos en tu bienestar: toallas frescas, productos de baño de marca y servicios esenciales en la habitación como lavadora/secadora, plancha y tabla de planchar, además de caja fuerte para tus objetos de valor. Nuestro equipo remoto estará siempre disponible para cubrir cualquier necesidad, garantizando que tu experiencia supere tus expectativas. En Master Mazeh Tel Aviv Serviced Apartments disfrutarás de la sensación de hogar con todos los servicios de un hotel, para que te relajes tras explorar la dinámica ciudad que tienes a la puerta.

subathens_master-plaka-athens__location.desc: Experience the charm of Plaka with master Plaka Athens. Explore narrow streets, neoclassical buildings, cafes, tavernas, and ancient ruins near the Acropolis

blocks.text: Located just below the Acropolis Hill, Plaka is one of the most picturesque neighborhoods in Athens, offering a delightful mix of history, culture, and charm. Its narrow streets, neoclassical buildings, and ancient ruins at every turn create an atmosphere that feels like stepping back in time.

Known for its lively cafes, traditional tavernas, and unique souvenir shops, Plaka exudes the nostalgic spirit of old Athens, setting it apart from the rest of the bustling city center. While popular with visitors, it retains an authentic charm, making it the perfect place to enjoy a leisurely stroll through its pedestrian-friendly streets.
At master Plaka Athens, you are perfectly positioned to explore this vibrant neighborhood, with iconic landmarks, cultural sites, and local flavors just steps from your door.

items: Here’s how to get to Apollonos 34 in Athens from different directions:

From Athens International Airport (ATH) 1. Metro: – Take the Metro Line 3 (the blue line) towards Agia Marina. – Transfer at Monastiraki Station to Line 1 (the green line) and get off at the next stop, Omonia. – From Omonia, you can walk or take a short taxi ride to Apollonos 34. 2. Taxi: – A taxi ride takes about 30-40 minutes and costs around €40-60, depending on traffic. 3. Bus: – Take the X95 bus to Syntagma Square. From there, it’s about a 10-minute walk to Apollonos 34.

From Athens City Center (Syntagma Square) 1. Walk: – It’s about a 10-minute walk. Head southeast towards Apollonos Street. 2.Taxi: – A taxi will take about 5 minutes. 3. Metro: – You can also take the Metro from Syntagma Station to Monastiraki Station on Line 1.

From Piraeus Port 1.Metro: – Take Metro Line 1 (the green line) towards Kifisia and transfer at Monastiraki Station to Line 3 to get closer if needed. 2. Taxi: – A taxi will take about 30 minutes, depending on traffic.

Are all apartments at master Bat Yam equipped with full kitchens including oven, microwave and dishwasher? Yes, every apartment features a fully equipped kitchen with stovetop, oven, microwave, dishwasher and full-size refrigerator.

How long does the master Bat Yam digital check-in process typically take to get verified? The digital verification process usually takes only a few minutes once documents are submitted.

Does master Bat Yam offer special rates for long-stay reservations? Yes, we offer special weekly, bi-weekly and monthly rates.

items: To get from Ben Gurion Airport to 4 Yohanan Hasandlar Street in Bat Yam, you can choose from several transportation options, including a taxi, shuttle service, or a combination of public transportation. Here are the steps for each option:

By taxi Taxis are readily available at Ben Gurion Airport 24/7. Follow these steps: 1. After exiting the airport terminal, follow the signs to the taxi stand. 2. Inform the taxi driver that you want to go to “4 Yohanan Hasandlar Street in Bat Yam.” 3. Make sure the taxi meter is turned on. The taxi will take you directly to your destination in Bat Yam. The journey may take approximately 30-45 minutes, depending on traffic.
By Private Shuttle You can pre-book a private shuttle service, such as a shared airport transfer or a private car, to take you from the airport to your destination.
Companies like SuperShuttle or various local providers offer these services.
Provide your flight details and address in advance when booking.

By Combination of Public Transportation You can use a combination of public transportation options, such as train and bus, to reach Bat Yam. Here’s how: 1. Take the train from Ben Gurion Airport to Tel Aviv. Follow the signs to the train station located within the airport complex. 2. Purchase a train ticket to Tel Aviv’s “HaHagana” or “Savidor Center” station. 3. From Tel Aviv, you can take a local bus or taxi to Bat Yam. 4. You can check the local bus routes that will take you closest to 4 Yohanan Hasandlar Street in Bat Yam.

blocks.text: * Make sure to check train and bus schedules in advance, especially if you arrive late at night or during holidays, as they may vary. Additionally, consider potential traffic delays when using taxis or buses to reach your destination in Bat Yam.

blocks.text: Hamburg, a dynamic port city on the Elbe River, showcases a rich cultural tapestry, awe-inspiring architecture, and a vibrant art scene. The metropolis reflects its maritime heritage and cosmopolitan spirit, featuring architectural marvels like the Elbphilharmonie, a contemporary concert hall resembling an ocean liner.

Near the center of Hamburg is Altona, a lively district and an ideal starting point for exploring the cultural treasures of the city. The district benefits from an efficient and easily accessible public transportation system. With the S-Bahn lines S1, S3, and S31, which serve as direct connections to popular destinations, visitors can easily reach the main sights and attractions. The distance between Altona and important tourist destinations such as the historic Speicherstadt, a UNESCO World Heritage site, is about three to four S-Bahn stations.

master Altona Hamburg’s serviced apartments immerse you in a district filled with trendy art galleries, cozy cafes, and cultural hotspots. As you stroll through Altona’s streets, you’ll encounter architectural wonders ranging from 19th-century townhouses to contemporary structures.
Whether your visit is for business or a family vacation, Hamburg’s unique blend of tradition and modernity ensures an enriching experience for all.

items: To get to Via in Arcione 98, 00187 Roma from Ciampino Airport (CIA) and Fiumicino Airport (FCO), here are your options:
From Ciampino Airport (CIA): Taxi: Taxis are available outside the airport. It takes about 30-40 minutes, and the fare to central Rome is around €30-€40.

Shuttle Bus + Metro: Take a shuttle bus (e.g., Terravision or SIT bus) from Ciampino Airport to Roma Termini (the main train station). The bus ride takes about 40 minutes and costs €5-€7. From Termini, take Metro Line A (direction Battistini) and get off at Barberini station. From there, it’s a 5-minute walk to Via in Arcione.

Train + Bus: Take a bus from Ciampino Airport to the Ciampino railway station (about 10 minutes). From there, take a regional train to Roma Termini (takes 15 minutes). Then follow the same directions from Termini as above.
From Fiumicino Airport (FCO): Taxi: A taxi ride takes around 40-50 minutes, and the fixed fare to central Rome is €48.

Leonardo Express Train + Metro: Take the Leonardo Express from Fiumicino to Roma Termini. The train runs every 15 minutes, and the journey takes 32 minutes. Tickets cost €14. From Termini, take Metro Line A (direction Battistini) and get off at Barberini station.

Bus + Metro: Take a shuttle bus (Terravision, SIT bus) from Fiumicino Airport to Roma Termini (about 45-60 minutes, costs €6-€8). From Termini, take Metro Line A to Barberini. Via in Arcione is centrally located near the Trevi Fountain, so it’s well-connected by public transport.

items: To get from Ben Gurion Airport to 38 Shenkin Street in Tel Aviv, you have several transportation options. The most common methods are by taxi, private shuttle, or public transportation. Here are the steps for each option:
By taxi Taxis are readily available at Ben Gurion Airport 24/7. Follow the signs to the taxi stand.
Simply tell the taxi driver you want to go to “38 Shenkin Street in Tel Aviv.” Make sure the meter is turned on.
The journey to Shenkin Street from the airport should take approximately 20-30 minutes, depending on traffic.
By Private Shuttle You can pre-book a private shuttle service, such as a shared airport transfer or a private car, to take you from the airport to your destination.
Companies like SuperShuttle or various local providers offer these services.
Make sure to provide your flight details and address in advance when booking.
Public Transportation Take the train: There is a train station at Ben Gurion Airport connected to the airport terminal. Purchase a train ticket to Tel Aviv’s “HaHagana” or “Savidor Center” station.
From the train station, you can take a taxi or public transportation to Shenkin Street.
Take a bus: Ben Gurion Airport is served by several bus lines. Take Bus Line 445 or 475 to Tel Aviv’s central bus station (Arlozorov).
From there, you can transfer to other buses or use a taxi to reach Shenkin Street.

blocks.text: *Please note that public transportation schedules may vary, so it’s a good idea to check in advance, especially if you arrive late at night or during holidays. Additionally, traffic conditions in Tel Aviv can impact the travel time, so consider this when planning your journey.

Is master Wola set up for business travellers on a corporate stay in Warsaw? Yes. Every apartment includes a dedicated workspace, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a fully equipped kitchen. The property is located in Wola, Warsaw’s main business district, with easy metro access. Corporate rates are available on request.

Is master Wola suitable for a long-term stay of several weeks or more? Yes. Fully equipped kitchens, self-service laundry facilities, weekly housekeeping, and apartment-style layouts make master Wola a comfortable and practical base for stays of any length.

Are the apartments at master Wola fitted with air-conditioning and heating? Yes, each apartment has individual controls; however, the system operates seasonally, switching between heating or cooling rather than both simultaneously.

Does every apartment at master Wola include a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher and oven? Yes, each apartment features a full kitchen complete with dishwasher, combination microwave-oven and cookware.
Is there Netflix or any streaming service in the master Wola apartments? Yes, every unit offers a Smart TV pre-loaded with Netflix for guest streaming entertainment.
Is there a gym at master Wola? Yes, complimentary entry to the fully equipped Leonardo Hotel gym is included during the stay.
What is the maximum number of guests per apartment at master Wola? Our Spacious Family Two-Bedroom Apartments comfortably host up to eight guests within an expansive 85 m² layout.
Is a personal in-room safebox provided in each master Wola apartment? Yes, an electronic safe is installed inside every apartment for secure storage of valuables.

Is there a washing machine in the master Wola apartment or a shared laundry room? At master Wola, guests have access to a shared self-service laundry room equipped with complimentary laundry detergent. Additionally, our Three-Bedroom Apartments feature the exclusive benefit of private, in-unit washing machines and dryers.

Do any apartments at master Wola offer accessible features such as walk-in showers and wider doorways? Our Three-bedroom apartments include step-free walk-in showers with wider doorways; however, the property does not meet the full requirements to be considered officially accessible.
Are work desks or dedicated laptop workspaces available in master Wola apartments? Yes, dining tables double as spacious laptop workstations and include convenient power outlets nearby.
Does master Wola supply complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer in all bathrooms? Yes, all bathrooms are stocked with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer is provided in every apartment.

What apartment sizes are available at master Wola? Studios start at 30 m², Studios with Sofa Bed are 38 m², One-Bedrooms 43 m², Two-Bedrooms 70 m², Three-Bedrooms 95 m², and Family Two-Bedroom apartments up to 85 m².

Can food be delivered from apps like Wolt or Uber Eats to master Wola apartments? Yes, guests can order via apps such as Wolt or Uber Eats. Couriers deliver to the building entrance, where guests collect their orders directly.

Does master Wola have its own restaurant or bar, or is it mainly self-catering? master Wola offers the best of both worlds: it is fully self-catering with equipped kitchens for home-cooked meals, yet guests also enjoy access to the restaurant and bar at the neighboring Leonardo Royal Hotel Warsaw.
Does master Wola supply cookware, dishware, and utensils in every apartment kitchen? Yes, full sets of pots, pans, plates, glasses and utensils are stocked in all kitchens.

Is a coffee machine and kettle provided in the kitchens at master Wola? Yes, every kitchen is fully equipped for your morning routine, featuring an electric kettle and a Nespresso capsule coffee machine.

Does master Wola offer breakfast service through the neighboring Leonardo Royal Hotel Warsaw? Yes! You can choose a breakfast-inclusive rate when booking, or simply pay the Leonardo Hotel directly on the morning of your visit.

Is room-service meal delivery available to master Wola apartments? Yes, guests are welcome to order room service from the neighboring Leonardo Hotel. Please contact us for further details to place an order.
Is there a supermarket or grocery store within a five-minute walk of master Wola? Yes, several convenience stores and mini-markets are within a five-minute walk of master Wola.

What is master Wola’s flexible cancellation policy for stays under two weeks? Cancellation terms depend on the chosen rate: flexible bookings may be cancelled free of charge until the stated deadline, while non-refundable rates are prepaid and cannot be cancelled.

Does master Wola require a security deposit or pre-authorization at check-in? No security deposit is taken, but a valid credit card is required and may be pre-authorised for any damages or incidentals.

Are dogs allowed at master Wola, and what is the nightly fee? Yes, master Wola welcomes trained dogs for an additional charge of 80 PLN per night; they must never be left unattended, stay off sofas and beds, and any damage is the guest’s responsibility.
What payment methods does master Wola accept for accommodation charges? Payments are processed via a secure online link accepting major credit and debit cards.
What is the minimum guest age for check-in at master Wola? At least one guest in each reservation must be 18 years of age or older.
Are parties or events permitted inside master Wola apartments? No, parties, events or loud gatherings are forbidden under the house rules.

Are children and infants welcome at master Wola, and are travel cots available on request? Yes, children of all ages are welcome. Travel cots can be arranged on request, subject to availability – please notify the team ahead of arrival.

Can an extra bed be added to the master Wola apartment? master Wola does not provide rollaway or extra beds. Guests requiring additional sleeping capacity should select a Studio with Sofa Bed or a larger apartment at the time of booking.

Does the total price at master Wola include VAT and Warsaw city tax? The confirmed rate includes VAT. Warsaw does not currently impose a mandatory tourist tax, so the quoted price reflects the full cost.
Which metro station is closest to master Wola, and how many minutes is the walk? Rondo ONZ Metro Station is the nearest stop, located just a five-minute walk away.
How far is master Wola from the Warsaw Uprising Museum on foot? The Warsaw Uprising Museum is less than 1.5 km from master Wola.
What is the distance between master Wola and Warsaw Central Railway Station? Warsaw Central Station is approximately a 1.4-kilometre walk away, or about a 10-minute drive, depending on traffic.
How long does a taxi ride from Warsaw Chopin Airport to master Wola usually take? A standard taxi journey from Chopin Airport averages twenty-five minutes in normal city traffic.
How close is master Wola to the Palace of Culture and Science? The Palace of Culture and Science is located within 1.7 km from master Wola.
What is the exact address of master Wola? master Wola is located at Grzybowska 45, 00-844 Warszawa, Poland, in the heart of Warsaw’s Wola business and cultural district.

How does check-in work at master Wola? The property operates with a self-check-in system. Your unique apartment PIN code will be sent to you via WhatsApp and email at 9:00 AM on your arrival day. To ensure timely delivery, please confirm your reservation is fully paid and your online registration is complete.
Does master Wola provide luggage storage before check-in and after check-out? Yes, a secure luggage room allows guests to store bags before arrival or after departure.
Is early check-in or late check-out available at master Wola, and are extra fees applied? Early arrival or late departure can be arranged subject to availability and may incur additional fees.
What are the standard check-in and check-out times at master Wola? Check-in begins at 3:00 PM and check-out is required by 11:00 AM on departure day.
How far in advance does master Wola send the digital access code before arrival? The entry details and personal PIN code are provided 9:00 AM on arrival day.

Will I need to provide a copy of my ID or passport before receiving the master Wola access code? Yes, guests are required to complete a digital identity verification step before the access code is issued, via the pre-arrival registration link sent by the team.

What should I do if my access code does not work when I arrive at master Wola? Please contact the Guest Relations Team immediately via WhatsApp (+48 22 103 8004) or email (easytravelagency@trustagent.space). A representative will verify your booking and assist.

How and when can I request an official invoice for my stay at master Wola? Official invoices can be requested during the booking process or after check-out by contacting our support team via WhatsApp or email. Please note that invoices are issued upon check-out; if you require specific details or company information on your invoice, kindly notify us before your departure date.
What restaurants and cafés are within a five-minute walk of master Wola? Guests reach Food Town, Browar Warszawski, Primitivo Wine Bar and several cafés within five minutes.
Which green parks near master Wola are suitable for jogging or relaxing? Park Świętokrzyski and Park Mirowski are both within 1.8km and ideal for outdoor exercise.
How far is Warsaw Old Town from master Wola, and is it easily reachable by public transport? Warsaw Old Town lies roughly two kilometres away and is easily reached by direct tram in fifteen minutes.

Are late-night grocery stores available close to master Wola? Yes, late-night grocery stores are located within a short radius of master Wola, providing easy access to groceries and supplies around the clock.

Which shopping centres can guests quickly reach from master Wola? You’ll find excellent shopping nearby! The unique boutiques at Norblin Factory are just 0.5 km away, while the larger Złote Tarasy shopping mall is located 1.6 km from the property.

Can guests of master Wola easily visit Warsaw’s Jewish Heritage sites? Yes, The POLIN Museum of the History of Polish Jews and the remains of the Warsaw Ghetto boundary wall are within walking distance or a tram ride from master Wola.
Are there parking facilities available near master Wola? Yes, there are nearby public garages.

top_privacy.title: privacy | master
top_privacy.desc: Your privacy matters at master Serviced Apartments. Enjoy a secure and tranquil stay with our utmost commitment to safeguarding your data.

blocks.text: Welcome to master’s Privacy Notice. Gala Home LTD, together with its subsidiaries GALA MASTERS (UK) LIMITED (in the UK) and Gala Master GmbH (in Austria), doing business as “master”, respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy notice will inform you about how we collect and process your personal data. This includes when you make a booking, request information from us, contact us (or we contact you), use our website(s)/apps, connect with us via social media, through our contact center or hotels, or any other engagement we have with you (regardless of where you are based). It also informs you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you. This privacy notice is provided in a layered format so you can click through to the specific areas set out below.

items: IMPORTANT INFORMATION AND WHO WE ARE
THE DATA WE COLLECT ABOUT YOU
HOW IS YOUR PERSONAL DATA COLLECTED
HOW WE USE YOUR PERSONAL DATA

blocks.text: 1. IMPORTANT INFORMATION AND WHO WE ARE PURPOSE OF THIS PRIVACY NOTICE

This privacy notice aims to provide you with information on how Gala Home LTD collects and processes your personal data in our dealings with you, including in providing accommodation and other services to you, including any data you may provide through our website. On the use of cookies, we provide an additional notice which you can find here. This general privacy notice may be supplemented by other special notices we may provide on specific occasions when we are collecting or processing personal data about you so that you are fully aware of how and why we are using your data. This privacy notice supplements our other special notices and is not intended to override them.

Gala Home LTD is the data controller for the relevant processing of personal data. Gala Home LTD operates properties in Israel (master Shenkin, master Haifa, master Beer Sheva, master Mazeh, master Bat Yam), Austria (master Mirabell, master Linzergasse), and the UK (master St. Paul). Gala Master GmbH and GALA MASTERS (UK) LIMITED are subsidiaries of Gala Home LTD and operate properties in Austria and the UK, respectively.

You can reach our data protection officer (DPO) at: Email address: easytravelagency@trustagent.space Postal address: Gala Home LTD, Yigal Alon 94, Tel Aviv, Israel You have the right to make a complaint at any time to the data protection authority supervising us. We would, however, appreciate the chance to deal with your concerns before you approach the authority, so please contact us or our DPO in the first instance.
2. THE DATA WE COLLECT ABOUT YOU

Personal data, or personal information, means any information about an individual from which that person can be identified. We may collect, use, store, and transfer different kinds of personal data about you, which we have grouped together as follows:

items: Identity Data includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier, marital status, title, date of birth, nationality, passport or ID card number (where legally required), gender, and car number plate. If your booking is made by your employer or you notify us, we may also collect the name and contact data of your employer and your job position if you are a business contact.
Contact Data includes billing address, home address, email address, fax and telephone numbers.
Special Requirements Data includes health, disability, and religious or dietary requirements if you notify us of any special needs and provide this information.

Booking and Transaction Data includes bank account or payment card details and details about payments, purpose of stay, and other details of your bookings, stays, and other services you have purchased from us, as well as comments and responses to surveys you provide relating to our service.

Technical Data of your Visit to this Website includes internet protocol (IP) address, your login data, browser type and version, time zone setting and location, browser plug-in types and versions, operating system and platform, and other technology on the devices you use to access this website.
Usage Data includes information about how you use our services, or link with us via social media and our website.
Special Traveler’s Data includes information about your recent stays/traveling, Covid test, and Covid symptoms as may be required by Federal or local law in connection with the Corona pandemic.

blocks.text: We will not collect all the data referred to above in each case but only such data as required for the specific purpose.
IF YOU FAIL TO PROVIDE PERSONAL DATA

Where we need to collect personal data by law or under the terms of a contract we have with you and you fail to provide that data when requested, we may not be able to perform the contract we have or are trying to enter into with you (for example, to provide you with accommodation or our other services). In this case, we may have to cancel a booking or other service you have with us, but we will notify you if this is the case at the time.
3. HOW IS YOUR PERSONAL DATA COLLECTED?
We use different methods to collect data from and about you, including through:

items: Direct interactions . You may give us your Identity, Contact, Special Traveler’s Data, and Booking and Transaction Data by filling in forms (on paper, check-in kiosk, or web/mobile application) or by corresponding with us by post, phone, email, via our website, chatbot, on social media, or otherwise. This includes personal data you provide when you: Make a booking for one of our hotels, whether for overnight stays, day rooms, functions, or conferences.
Check in to one of our hotels.
Attend a function, conference, or otherwise use the facilities at one of our hotels.
Subscribe to our newsletter and/or other publications.
Request a brochure or other promotional or marketing materials to be sent to you.
Enter a competition or respond to a promotion.
Respond to a survey or give us feedback.
Book a service provided by a hotel (e.g., Transportation services).

Automated technologies or interactions. As you visit our website, interact with our chatbot, our online check-in applications, or via social media, we may automatically collect Technical Data about your equipment, browsing actions, and patterns. We collect this personal data by using cookies, e-mails, server logs, and other similar technologies. Please see our Cookie Policy for further details.

Travel agencies or other third parties acting on your or your employer’s behalf . We may receive personal data about you if a booking is made for you by a travel agency, online portal, or another third person acting on your behalf or on behalf of your employer or other third party (e.g., tour operators, Online Travel Agencies, Global Distribution Systems).
HTML email web beacons . Our emails may contain a single, campaign-unique “web beacon pixel” to tell us whether our emails are opened and verify any clicks through to links within the email.

Other third parties or publicly available sources . We may receive personal data about you from third parties and public sources such as web and social media analytics providers, advertising networks, web interaction technology providers, publicly available trade registers, and feedback on different online portals and review sites.

Monitoring. We may monitor and/or record transactions and activities at all points of contact, as well as web, social media, and app traffic and activities. These are done to ensure the accuracy of your instructions, for training purposes, to improve our services, and to ensure security and prevent fraud. We also use CCTV in and around our premises for the security of our guests and patrons, as well as to prevent and detect crime.

Business Contacts. If you are a business contact of Gala Home LTD, we may receive your data as you interact with our website, from trade fair visits/workshops, personal meetings, correspondence through emails and phone, contractual negotiations, and agreements.

blocks.text: 4. HOW WE USE YOUR PERSONAL DATA

items: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to do so. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
Performance of contract: Where we need to provide the booked accommodation and services, or otherwise perform the contract we have entered into with you (or are about to enter into).
Consent : Where you provide us with your explicit consent.
Legitimate interests : Where it is necessary for our legitimate interests (or those of a third party) and your interests and fundamental rights do not override those interests.
Comply with obligation : Where we need to comply with a legal or regulatory obligation.
Vital interests : In the case of any accident or medical or other emergency, to protect your or another individual’s vital interests, where you or they are not able to give consent.

blocks.text: For any processing that is based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw such consent at any time by contacting us.
PURPOSES FOR WHICH WE WILL USE YOUR PERSONAL DATA
We collect and process your personal data for purposes such as:

items: Making a booking, including reserving disability adapted accommodation, providing accommodation and other services to you, managing your stay at the hotel, and monitoring the use of our services.
Dealing with issues, complaints, or disputes arising out of our relationship with you and preventing or detecting crime, including fraud.

Managing our relationship with you, which includes notifying you about changes to our terms or privacy policy, asking you to leave a review or take a survey, or participate in a prize draw or competition.

Administering and protecting our business, including our website, delivering relevant website content and advertisements to you, measuring or understanding the effectiveness of the advertising we serve to you, and making suggestions and recommendations to you about our services that may be of interest to you.
Using data analytics to improve our website, services, marketing, customer relationships, and experiences.
Dealing with accidents, medical emergencies, or other emergencies.
Complying with local legislation, such as storing accounting documents or registration cards and asking for Special Traveler’s Data.
Offering you further services from the hotel or third parties relating to your stay at the hotel (e.g., transportation services, tickets for sights, etc.).

blocks.text: We do not undertake automated decision-making using your personal data.

We strive to provide you with choices regarding certain personal data uses, particularly around marketing and advertising. Where you have agreed to receive it and provided your consent, we may use your Identity, Contact, Technical, Usage, and Profile Data to form a view on what we think you may want or need, or what may be of interest to you. This is how we decide which services and offers may be relevant for you.
You can revoke your consent and unsubscribe from our marketing communication at any time by following the opt-out links on any marketing message sent to you or by contacting us at any time.
SURVEY EMAIL, RELATED SERVICES OFFER, INFORMATION EMAILS

You can object to receiving emails asking you to take part in a survey, informing you about related services, or providing information about the possibility to check-in online at any time by following the opt-out links on any such message sent to you or by contacting us at any time.
We use cookies on our website. For more information about the cookies we use, the purposes for which we use them, and how you can manage your cookie preferences, please see our Cookie Policy.

We will only use your personal data for the purposes for which we collected it, unless we reasonably consider that we need to use it for another reason, and that reason is compatible with the original purpose. If you wish to get an explanation as to how the processing for the new purpose is compatible with the original purpose, please contact us. If we need to use your personal data for an unrelated purpose, we will notify you and we will explain the legal basis that allows us to do so.
Please note that we may process your personal data without your knowledge or consent, in compliance with the above rules, where this is required or permitted by law.
We may share your personal data with the parties set out below for the purposes set out in this privacy notice:

items: Other entities within the Gala Home LTD group, including subsidiaries and affiliates, to provide our services to you and for internal administrative purposes.

Third-party service providers who provide services such as IT and system administration, payment processing, customer service, marketing, survey, data analysis, and other similar services to enable them to provide their services to us and to you.
Business partners, suppliers, and sub-contractors for the performance of any contract we enter into with you.
Professional advisers including lawyers, bankers, auditors, and insurers who provide consultancy, banking, legal, insurance, and accounting services.

Law enforcement or regulatory agencies, government bodies, courts, or other third parties if we believe disclosure is necessary (i) as a matter of applicable law or regulation, (ii) to exercise, establish, or defend our legal rights, or (iii) to protect your vital interests or those of any other person.

Potential buyers or investors in the event of a proposed merger, acquisition, or any form of sale or transfer of some or all of our assets. In the event of such a transaction, we will ensure that the recipient agrees to treat your personal data in a manner consistent with this privacy notice.

blocks.text: We require all third parties to respect the security of your personal data and to treat it in accordance with the law. We do not allow our third-party service providers to use your personal data for their own purposes, and we only permit them to process your personal data for specified purposes and in accordance with our instructions.

We may share your personal data within the group and. All companies are currently based in the European Economic Area (EEA), UK, or Israel (where the EU Commission decided that the country provides an adequate level of data protection).

Though we do not seek actively to transfer personal data outside the EEA, UK or Israel, some of the external third parties we deal with are based outside these territories or process personal data outside these territories, so their processing of your personal data will involve a transfer of data outside these territories.

Whenever we transfer your personal data out of the country where it was collected, we ensure a similar degree of protection is afforded to it by implementing appropriate safeguards. For transfers to countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA), this may include entering into standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission or relying on other legal mechanisms, such as the EU-US Privacy Shield framework (which has been invalidated as of July 16, 2020, by the judgment of the Court of Justice of the European Union).
Please contact us if you want further information on the specific mechanism used by us when transferring your personal data out of the country where it was collected.

We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used, or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered, or disclosed. In addition, we limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors, and other third parties who have a business need to know. They will only process your personal data on our instructions and they are subject to a duty of confidentiality.
We have put in place procedures to deal with any suspected personal data breach and will notify you and any applicable regulator of a breach where we are legally required to do so.
We will only retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements.

To determine the appropriate retention period for personal data, we consider the amount, nature, and sensitivity of the personal data, the potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure of your personal data, the purposes for which we process your personal data, and whether we can achieve those purposes through other means, and the applicable legal requirements.

In some circumstances, we may anonymize your personal data (so that it can no longer be associated with you) for research or statistical purposes, in which case we may use this information indefinitely without further notice to you.
Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data. These rights may include:

items: Request access to your personal data.
Request correction of your personal data.
Request erasure of your personal data.
Object to the processing of your personal data.
Request restriction of processing your personal data.
Request the transfer of your personal data.

blocks.text: If you wish to exercise any of the rights set out above, please contact us.

You will not have to pay a fee to access your personal data (or to exercise any of the other rights). However, we may charge a reasonable fee if your request is clearly unfounded, repetitive, or excessive. Alternatively, we may refuse to comply with your request in these circumstances.

We may need to request specific information from you to help us confirm your identity and ensure your right to access your personal data (or to exercise any of your other rights). This is a security measure to ensure that personal data is not disclosed to any person who has no right to receive it. We may also contact you to ask you for further information in relation to your request to speed up our response.

We try to respond to all legitimate requests within one month. Occasionally, it may take us longer than a month if your request is particularly complex or you have made a number of requests. In this case, we will notify you and keep you updated.

items: Scope of application These terms and conditions shall apply to any rental provision of apartments for accommodation purposes and to any further services provided by the property to its customers.
Subletting of the provided apartments for other than accommodation purposes requires the prior written consent of the property.
Terms and conditions of the customer shall only be applicable if they have been the subject of an express prior written agreement.

Contract conclusion, contracting parties, limitation of contractual liability and limitation period The accommodation contract becomes effective upon acceptance of the customer’s booking request by the property. At its own discretion, the property may confirm the apartments reservation in writing.

Contracting parties are the booked property, hereinafter referred to as “the property”, and the customer. If a third party placed the order on behalf of the customer, the third party and the customer shall be liable as joint and several debtors to the property for all obligations arising from the accommodation contract.

The property shall be liable for its obligations arising under the accommodation contract. However, for deficiencies in areas not typical of its performance, this liability is limited to cases involving intent or gross negligence of the property.
All claims asserted by the customer against the property shall become time-barred after six months.
The above-mentioned limitations of liability and limitation period also apply in favour of the property in case of infringement of pre-contractual duties or positive breach contract.

Payment for Reservations via the master Website All online credit card transactions carried out are subject to an authentication process carried out by the credit card company, namely “3DSecure” for Visa/Mastercard or “Safekey” for American Express, regardless of whether the reservation relates to a prepaid or non prepaid rate.

Online credit card transactions for prepaid reservations: If the customer chooses to pay with a credit card for a prepaid rate, the customer is required to provide valid credit card details at the end of the reservation process. The payment transaction is carried out by the customer’s credit card company after having completed the authentication process successfully, the credit card is charged directly with the full reservation amount and a so called “Credit Card Token” is generated. The Credit Card Token is an encryption of the credit card type and number. The Credit Card Token is stored for a defined period of time for any payment obligations incurred by the customer that are not settled before or during the customer’s stay at the property. The property reserves the right to charge the Credit Card Token at any time during the storage period for any such payment obligations, including no-show or cancellation fees. Charging the Credit Card Token will incur customer’s credit card company to carry out a payment transaction and charge the customer’s credit card.

Online credit card transactions for non prepaid reservations: Non-prepaid reservations may require the customer to provide valid credit card details at the end of the reservation process as a guarantee for any charges not settled in the property. After having completed the authentication process successfully, a Credit Card Token is generated. The Credit Card Token is stored for a defined period of time for any payment obligations incurred by the customer that are not settled before or during the customer’s stay at the property. The property reserves the right to charge the Credit Card Token at any time during the storage period for any such payment obligations, including no-show or cancellation fees, but not before the day of the reserved accommodation date. Charging the Credit Card Token will incur customer’s credit card company to carry out a payment transaction and charge the customer’s credit card.
The property reserves the right not to offer certain payment options or to refer to other payment options. The payment options available will be displayed during the reservation process.
Performances, rates, payment, set-off The company is obliged to hold the rooms booked by the customer and to provide the mutually agreed services.

The customer is obliged to pay the applicable room rates and for other services as agreed upon. This shall also apply to any services provided or expenses made by the property to third parties on the customer’s request.

The agreed rates include value-added tax (Except for properties in Israel that may show prices excluding VAT for non-Israelis, based on language and IP locations, and according to Israeli VAT regulations). Increases of value-added tax shall be borne by the customer. If the period between conclusion and performance of the contract exceeds four months, the property may raise the contractually agreed rates to a reasonable extent but not more than 10%, if the generally charged rates for such services have increased.

The property may also adjust the agreed rates if it gives consent to changes requested by the customer after conclusion of the contract such as amending the number of booked apartments, the length of stay or property services to be provided.

Any invoice issued by the property without indication of a due date is payable without deduction within 10 days upon receipt of the given invoice. The property is entitled to declare its accrued receivables to be due at any time and to demand immediate payment thereof. In case of delayed payment, the property is entitled to charge 5% interest above base interest rate. Each party, the property and the customer can claim lower or higher damages.

Considering the law on package travel, the property is entitled to demand adequate advance or security payments when the contract is concluded or thereafter. The amount and payment deadlines of advance or security payments shall be agreed upon in the contract.
The customer may offset or reduce a claim of the property only with an indisputable or legally binding claim.

Rescission by the customer (cancellation, no show) Customer’s rescission of the concluded contract requires the property’s written consent. If the property does not confirm the customer’s rescission in writing, the contractually agreed rate must be fully paid, even in the case, the customer does not avail himself of the contractual services. This does not apply in case of a performance default of the property or other cases in which the property is at fault.

If property and customer contractually agreed upon a deadline for charge-free rescission of the contract, the customer may rescind from the contract up to that date without incurring payment or damage compensation claims by the property. The customer’s right of rescission expires if he does not exercise his right of rescission in writing by the agreed deadline, except in case of performance default of the property or other cases in which the property is at fault.
In case of cancellation by the customer without giving prior notice and without agreement with the property, the full reservation fee must be paid.

At its own discretion, the property may require the customer to compensate the incurred damages on a lump sum basis. Then, the customer is obliged to pay 90 % of the contractually agreed rate for lodging with or without breakfast, 70 % for half-board and 60 % for full-board arrangements. The customer shall be entitled to prove evidence to the extent that either no damages were incurred by the property or that damages incurred by the property were lower than the amount charged.

Rescission by the property If the customer has a contractual right for charge-free rescission within a certain deadline, the property for its part is entitled to rescind the contract during that deadline, if other customers made booking requests concerning the reserved rooms and the customer does not waive his right of rescission upon inquiry of the property.

The property is entitled to rescind the contract, if an advance payment was not made within the agreed deadline, even after setting an appropriate additional payment period in connection with a notice of refusal.

Furthermore, the property has the right for extraordinary rescission of the contract for materially justifiable reasons, such as force majeure or other circumstances for which the property is not responsible and which render impossible the fulfilment of the contract; if rooms have been booked with misleading or false information concerning essential facts such as the identity of the customer or purpose of stay; or if the property has a legitimate reason to assume that the use of property services might jeopardize the unobstructed business operations, the safety or the reputation in public, without being attributable to the property’s sphere of control or organization; in case of violation of section I. paragraph 2., see above.
The property has to give immediate notification to the customer about exercising its right of rescission.
In case of justified rescission by the property, the customer shall have no further claims for compensation.
Apartment availability, delivery and return The customer does not acquire the right to be provided with specific rooms.
Booked apartments are not available to the customer before 3:00 p.m. on the agreed arrival date. The customer does not acquire the right to earlier availability of the booked rooms.

Rooms must be vacated and made available to the property not later than 11:00 noon on the agreed departure date. Thereafter, the company may charge 50% of the full accommodation rate (list price), if the customer vacates the room later than contractually agreed but not later than 6:00 p.m. or 100% if the customer vacates the room later than 6:00 p.m. The customer shall be entitled to prove evidence that either no damages were incurred by the property or that damages incurred by the property were lower than the charged amounts.

Liability of the property The property shall be liable for its contractual duties with the due diligence of a prudent businessman. However, its liability is limited to cases of deficiencies in areas not typical of its performance, damages, consequential damages or other service disruptions, which involve intent or gross negligence of the property. If deficiencies or other disruptions of the property services occur, the property will endeavour to take remedial action upon knowledge thereof or upon objection without undue delay by the customer. The customer is obliged to contribute reasonable assistance in the remedial action in order to minimize any possible damage.

For customer’s movables and belongings brought into the property, the property shall be liable according to statutory provisions up to the hundredfold of the room rate, maximum EUR 3,000.00. For cash, securities or other valuables up to EUR 750,00. Cash, securities or other valuables can be kept in the property safe or room safe up to a maximum value of EUR 25,000.00. The company strongly recommends making use of this facility. Liability claims expire unless the customer notifies the property of the loss, destruction or damage without undue delay.
The unlimited liability of the property is governed by the statutory provisions.

If the customer is provided with a parking space of the property’s parking lot or parking garage, no safekeeping agreement is concluded, even if a fee is charged. The property operator is only liable in case of intent or gross negligence and in accordance with the statutory provisions. The property cannot be held liable either for motor vehicles parked or manoeuvred on the property’s property or parking facilities nor its content if the damage is caused by a negligent breach of duty, which is not a cardinal duty. Cardinal duties are all essential contractual obligations, whose fulfilment is a prerequisite for the proper execution of the contract and upon which the contractual partner may regularly rely on. The liability for physical damages regarding life, body or health is not limited by this paragraph.

Privacy The companies doing business as “master” respect the confidentiality of the personal data of its customers. Under no circumstances, we will disclose personal data to third parties without your consent, except when we transmit customer’s name, email address or credit card information to the property of your choice or if disclosure of personal data is required by law. However, we reserve the right to disclose personal data to our affiliated group companies (in or outside the European Union), including our affiliated (group) companies’ employees and trustworthy representatives and agents who need to have our permission to access this personal data in order to carry out our services as requested by our customers. For further information, please also note our privacy and cookie policy.

Further Correspondence By completing your booking, you agree to receive Informational emails and text message communications (by WhatsApp or SMS), sent to you after completing your booking process containing all relevant details of your booking, check-in instructions, arrival information and

Informational emails and text message communications (by WhatsApp or SMS), we may send you during or after your stay in one of our properties, inviting you to complete our guest review form or other non-marketing correspondences.

Other than the mentioned correspondences above and the emails for which you may have actively opted in, we shall not send you any further notices, emails or correspondence, unless you specifically agree otherwise.

Final provisions Any amendment, supplement or alteration to the contract, the acceptance of booking or of these terms and conditions, including this provision, shall be valid only if made in writing. Unilateral amendments by the customer are not valid.

Should individual clauses of these terms and conditions be or become invalid, the validity of the remaining provisions shall remain unaffected. An invalid clause shall automatically be replaced with an effective and equivalent clause, which suits most the economic interests of the parties to the contract.
